title: PARKING BRAKE-CABLE ASM.
summary: Rear parking brake cables (emergency brake cables) from the frame crossmember back to each rear brake, all models. Each cable end fitting is snapped into a bracket with a spring retainer clip: at the front into a bracket screwed to the crossmember, and at the rear into a bracket on the trailing arm, with a guide near the brake backing plate. Includes the mandatory parking brake burnishing (break-in) procedure.

parts.name: RETAINER
parts.name_expanded: Retainer – spring clip for cable fitting

parts.name: BRACKET
parts.name_expanded: Bracket – parking brake cable, at crossmember

materials.where: cable [2] at the guide [1] near the rear brake

fastening.note: View A (LH shown, RH symmetrical): screw [5] goes through the bracket [4] flange into the crossmember.
Front end fitting of cable [2] passes through bracket [4]; retainer clip [3] pushes on from below to lock it. After installation rotate the clip so its open end faces downward from horizontal.

fastening.to: bracket on rear suspension trailing arm
fastening.note: Rear end fitting of cable [2] sits in a bracket on the trailing arm ahead of the brake; retainer clip [3] pushes on from below.

fastening.to: trailing arm near the rear brake backing plate
fastening.note: Cable [2] runs through guide [1] before entering the brake; grease 4e at this point.

notes: NOTE: After installation rotate clip so that the open end faces in a downward position from horizontal.
Mandatory parking brake burnishing: with car on roll test rolls and rear wheels driven at 50 MPH, apply parking brake until light drag is felt (10-12 notches on handle).
Hold for 55-60 seconds, then return the handle to released.
